item.title: Family-owned boot store owners claim same man has repeatedly stolen items from them for years
item.description: The owners of Yordi's Boots in north Houston are desperate for an arrest after they claim the same man has been stealing from their store for years, totaling hundreds of dollars lost.

item.title: Deputies find man shot to death inside east Harris Co. motel room while serving warrant, HCSO says
item.description: Officials said the man was possibly in an altercation with multiple people before being shot on Tuesday evening, HCSO said.

item.title: 20-year-old dead after several shots fired inside of SW Houston apartment complex, HPD says
item.description: Houston police said it appears that at least five or six suspects targeted a 20-year-old man and fired at least 20 shots inside a single unit on Tuesday night.

item.title: Texas man convicted of 2 fatal shootings becomes the 1st person executed in the US this year
item.description: Charles Victor Thompson received a lethal injection Wednesday evening at the state penitentiary in Huntsville, Texas.

item.title: Houston Solid Waste workers say long hours, safety risks are taking a toll
item.description: Long hours and safety concerns are just a few of the issues some Houston Solid Waste workers said they are facing.

item.title: Man exposing himself on METRO train shot dead during confrontation with deputies, HPD says
item.description: A suspect was shot to death after pulling out a knife on a deputy in a METRO transit center on Wednesday evening, according to authorities.

item.title: Search warrant FBI served at elections office near Atlanta seeks records tied to the 2020 elections
item.description: The search warrant the FBI served at a Fulton County elections office seeks records tied to the 2020 election, officials say.

item.title: Democrats poised to trigger government shutdown if White House won't meet demands for ICE reform
